title: DevSecOps Engineer - Final year Internship - Stage PFE
description: DevSecOps Engineer Intern - Final-Year Internship 2027 📍 Paris, France | 6-month internship | Start date: 2027 Join Escape Technologies’ DevSecOps team and help shape the infrastructure behind our AI cybersecurity platform. As an intern, you’ll collaborate with experienced engineers, strengthen your technical skills, and make an impact on projects spanning cloud infrastructure, automation, and security. What You’ll Work On Cloud & Infrastructure: Contribute to enhancing our AWS infrastructure and assist in deploying containerized applications using Docker and Kubernetes. Automation & CI/CD: Support GitLab CI pipeline development and infrastructure management with Terraform. Security: Integrate automated security checks, implement vulnerability scanning, and improve secrets management within our development workflows. Monitoring & Reliability: Boost observability with Grafana and Prometheus, and help troubleshoot technical issues. Development: Write scripts and backend tools in Python, TypeScript, or Go. You’ll receive guidance from Quentin, our DevSecOps Tech Lead, and take on increasing responsibility as you progress. About You Final-year student pursuing a masters degree in computer science, cybersecurity, or a related field Solid understanding of Linux, Git, networking, and at least one programming language Hands-on experience with Docker, cloud infrastructure, or CI/CD (via coursework, personal projects, or internships) Interested in security, adept at troubleshooting, and proactive in seeking help when needed Effective communicator in English Bonus: Experience with AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform, or monitoring tools. Personal projects, open source contributions, and homelabs are a big plus! Internship Requirements - Please Check Before Applying Six-month, final-year internship (stage de fin d’études) commencing in 2027 Enrolled in a school/university able to provide a valid internship agreement (convention de stage) for the full duration Available to work onsite at our Paris office Eligible to undertake an internship in France by your start date Our Recruitment Process 30-minute HR conversation 1-hour live coding exercise with Quentin 1-hour technical discussion with Engineering leadership 1.5-hour final meeting with the team and founders Ready to launch your DevSecOps career at the intersection of AI and cybersecurity?
